player_0.content: New plan: I failed to recognize that the Bedroom was a dead end and prematurely issued "DONE" while unvisited rooms (specifically the Lobby and potentially others) remained reachable. I treated the first room I entered as the final destination. Next time, I will strictly track the set of visited rooms. When I enter a new room, I will immediately check if any unvisited directions exist. If I am in a room with no unvisited neighbors, I will only issue "DONE" if I have visited every single room in the map. I will not stop until I have explicitly confirmed all rooms are visited.
